convention: Slot ids are BigWorld EXPOSED method indices, 0-based, assigned per direction over the flattened method list (interfaces first in <Implements> order, then the entity's own list, document order). All ClientMethods are exposed; Base/Cell methods only with <Exposed/>. When >62 methods are exposed, ids >= begSubSlot use top-index + u8 sub-index (BigWorld sub-slot scheme); no 0.6.5 entity reaches it (max exposed client methods: 23).
